topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic and outlines the core learning objectives.

topics.label: Traditional cancer treatments and systemic toxicities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss conventional cancer interventions including surgery, radiotherapy, and cytotoxic chemotherapy, alongside their associated toxicities and resistance mechanisms.

topics.label: Exploiting intrinsic cellular vulnerabilities and repair defects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe therapeutic approaches designed to exploit specific biological weaknesses in cancer cells such as hormone dependence, checkpoint loss, and defective DNA repair.

topics.label: Targeting oncogenic kinases and overcoming resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics focus on the rationale, mechanisms of action, and resistance pathways associated with small-molecule kinase inhibitors targeting oncogene addiction.

topics.label: Antibody-based targeted therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates are used to specifically target cancer cell surface proteins.

topics.label: Cancer immunology and T-cell-directed immunotherapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the role of immune surveillance and detail strategies that harness or engineer T cells to attack tumor cells.

topics.label: Progress, challenges, and future paradigms in cancer therapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate historical progress, persistent challenges like tumor heterogeneity, and emerging paradigms and dilemmas in cancer management.
